paper_title: The State of the Art in Constraining Axion-to-Nucleon Coupling and Non-Newtonian Gravity from Laboratory Experiments
notes: This is a review and compilation paper that aggregates constraints from multiple existing laboratory experiments. It does not present new experimental measurements. The paper reviews Casimir force measurements, neutron scattering results, and other laboratory constraints on Yukawa-type interactions and axion-to-nucleon couplings. Sections 2-4 compile existing results; Section 5 discusses proposed (not yet performed) experiments. The 'new' constraint shown in Figures 7-8 is cited from reference [76] (Klimchitskaya et al. 2020), which is a separate experimental work.
